3. **Single re-poll.** `gh pr view 42 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus` still returns UNKNOWN.
4. **Exit check.** The record is valid. The first matching row is "UNKNOWN after the single re-poll", which gives the obstacle `stuck - merge state unknown`.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves all four facts to holds: Case A re-polls exactly once, names the exit `stuck - merge state unknown`, keeps rounds 1/10 and syncs 2/10 untouched and dispatches nothing; Case B names `stuck - run record unreadable` and explicitly refuses to recreate repair.*, rebuild counters from chat, discover another record or infer course authority, offering only stop; Case C names `GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies`, treats reviewDecision purely as a locator with no rule attribution and no approve/wait row; and every menu is the shared obstacle template with stop recommended and last, show evidence in the trailing hint, no ordinary wait row and merge withheld. Before failed because it never recognized `deliver` as a course or syncs as a budget, re-derived the cap as 5 from the override, and rendered `fixable` overlays with a recommended numeric `wait` row and a numeric `show evidence` row in A and C, so no case exited stuck and the menu shape contradicted f4. Two small cleanups in After would make it tighter without losing anything: the `Verdict:` line in B and C still says `fixable - ...` while the exit line says `stuck - ...`, so align the verdict to the obstacle wording, and in B omit the `PR comments` observation of UNKNOWN only if the template intends that, otherwise keep it for consistency with A so the reader can see the green/UNKNOWN observations were still made before the record obstacle took precedence.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the intended course model cleanly: A re-polls exactly once and names the `stuck - merge state unknown` exit without touching rounds or syncs; B names `stuck - run record unreadable`, refuses to recreate the record, reset counters, search elsewhere, or borrow authority from the conversation; C states `GitHub reports BLOCKED, no local repair applies`, treats REVIEW_REQUIRED as a locator only, and never asks for someone else's approval; and all three use the obstacle template with eligible deliver/assess rows, stop recommended and last, show evidence demoted to a hint, no wait row and no automatic merge. Before failed these mainly because it had no named stuck exits, rendered per-action `wait` rows as the recommendation in A and C with stop neither recommended nor last, listed show evidence as a numeric row, and never stated the 'no local repair applies' finding for C. One point to watch in After's B: it runs the full pre-menu `gh pr view`/`gh run list` refresh even though the run record is unreadable; nothing here moved because of it, but if other scenarios expect a missing-record exit to perform no forge reads, keep B's narration restricted to the read failure plus the retained snapshot (as Before did) while retaining the new `stuck - run record unreadable` label and stop-only obstacle menu.
